Beginner-Friendly Walkthrough

How to Install & Use HomoeoAstra

New to HomoeoAstra? Follow these simple steps to install the app and repertorize your first patient case.

Install · Step 1

Download Your Edition

Tap the Download button for Normal, Pro, or Ultimate to save the .apk file to your Android phone or tablet.

Install · Step 2

Open the Downloaded File

Tap the file in your browser's Downloads list or your phone's Files app. If prompted, allow installation from your browser.

Install · Step 3

Tap Install & Start Offline

Tap Install and open the app. The complete repertory is built inside the app—no internet or login is required.
